related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以壓艙質量與浮力帳建立起點，接到濃度去除與失活差別的系統介面，最後用原理模型與型式驗證區別整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting, connect through Removal versus inactivation, then integrate evidence using Principle model versus type-approval evidence. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶壓艙水管理系統
history.text: 本專題以壓艙質量與浮力帳建立起點，接到濃度去除與失活差別的系統介面，最後用原理模型與型式驗證區別整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Ballast mass and buoyancy accounting, connect through Removal versus inactivation, then integrate evidence using Principle model versus type-approval evidence. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 分開壓艙功能與水處理效果，以水量、停留時間、濃度和抽樣證據建立處理流程模型。 在壓艙水流程與水質資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Separate ballasting function from treatment performance using water, time, concentration and sampling evidence. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ballast-water process and quality-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
